THE ENVIRONMENT PROTECTION AGENCY ACT, 2022
(ACT No. 15 of 2022)
THE PROTECTION OF THE OZONE LAYER AND Short title
SUBSTANCES COVERED IN THE MONTREAL
PROTOCOL REGULATIONS, 2025
In exercise of the powers conferred on the Minister under
section 77 of the Environment Protection Agency Act of 2022, the
Minister, after consultation with the Board, hereby makes the
following Regulations -
PART I–PRELIMINARY
1. In these Regulations unless the context otherwise requires- Interpretation.
''Act'' means the Environment Protection Agency
Act, 2022 (Act No. 15 of 2022);
''Agency'' means the Environment Protection Agency
established under section 2 (1) of the Environment
Protection Agency Act, 2022 (Act No. 15 of 2022);
''Authorised officer'' means a person authorised by the
Agency to exercise a power specified in the Act, or
these regulations;
 2
''chlorofluorocarbons'' means a fully halogenited
chlorofluorocarbon each molecule of which contains
one, two or three carbonations in the catergories set
out in the Fourth Schcdule of the Act;
"controlled substance" means a controlled substance
set out in the fourth schedule to the Act and any
addition that may from time to time be made thereto
and includes chlorofluorocarbons, halon, carbon
tetrachloride, 1,1,1, trichloroethane, methyl bromide,
hydrochlorofluorocarbons, hydrofluorocarbons and
other fully halogenated substances whether virgin,
recovered, recycled or reclaimed;
"critical use" means the use of methyl bromide that
conforms to Decision IX/6 set out in Report of the
Ninth Meeting of the Parties to the Montreal Protocol
on Substances that Deplete the Ozone Layer,
published by the Ozone Secretariat, United Nations
Environment Programme;
"halon" means an abominated chemical related to a
chlorofluorocarbon, used in firefighting and having
a very high ozone depleting potentials set out in
colum III of the Fourth Schedule including their
isomers;
"hydrochlorofluorocarbon" means is a compound
consisting of hydrogen, bromine, fluorine, and
carbon;
''hydrofluorocarbon'' means sythetic greenhouse gases
that is used in air cordintioning, refregiration and
other applications;
''Montreal Protocol'' means a treaty agreed on 16
September, 1987 designed to reduce the production
and consumption of ozone depleting substances in
order to reduce their abundance in the atmosphere,
and thereby protect the earth's fragile ozone layer.

2. The purpose of these regulations is to- Purpose.
(a) prevent release into the atmosphere of
substances that result in depletion of the
stratospheric ozone layer and minimize global
warming;and
(b) lay down provisions governingthe
productions, import, export, placing on the
market use, recovery, recycling, reclamination
and destruction.

(a) substances including their isomers whether
existing alone or in a mixture, that are set out
in the Fourth Schedule to the Act, and those
that may be added thereto from time to time;
and
(b) products containing or designed to contain
those substances.
(2) These regulations shall not apply to equipment or
products which have been exempted, by acquiring a permit from the
Agency for critical use.
